rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a part or subdivision, including a general part of a document.

example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 fan6 hai6 gong2 on1 cyun4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a distinct or numbered major section of a document, rather than just any part of it.

example.english: This section mainly discusses the contract terms.
example.traditional: 呢一章節主要講合約條款。
example.jyutping: nei1 jat1 zoeng1 zit3 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2

rows.note: Use this for a physical piece cut out from a larger object, especially a chunk or block.

example.english: I cut out a section of the cake for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 cit3 zo2 jat1 faai3 daan6 gou1 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for an image showing an object as though it had been cut along a plane.

example.english: This section diagram clearly shows the tunnel's internal structure.
example.traditional: 呢張剖面圖清楚顯示條隧道入面嘅結構。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 pau2 min6 tou4 cing1 co2 hin2 si6 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 jap6 min6 ge3 git3 kau3
